supplementary_marginal_patch_data.why_this_is_not_a_verdict: The measured effect combines: (1) the actual PR #3868 diff, (2) the ~14-line drift between pod's pre-refactor bundle.py and the PR's actual base (which already refactored pool-allocation into a body-emitted device_mem_allocate). We cannot separate these two contributions from this data. Any of the observed movement — sdsc_bundle_gen +65%, dxp_standalone -33% — could belong to either.
